documents.title: North Visitor Permit Policy
documents.text: Meridian North visitor permit requests must be submitted through the North reception portal. Requests have a target acknowledgement time of two business hours. The visitor permit fee is 25 credits per permit. This policy does not specify a permit issuance deadline or a parking reimbursement amount.

documents.title: South Visitor Permit Policy
documents.text: Meridian South visitor permit requests must be submitted through the South facilities portal. Requests have a target acknowledgement time of five business days. This policy does not specify a visitor permit fee, a permit issuance deadline or a parking reimbursement amount.
